# Flow 0 · Set provider (first screen)

Back to the guide: [README.md](README.md) · all cases: [TEST-CASES.md](TEST-CASES.md). Mark each case in the app with `/tests` (p / f / s).

## 0 Set provider (first screen)

Reconix needs the Core API running (./deploy/dev.sh). Every plan, step, finding and chat answer comes from it; the AI it uses is the built-in Reconix model, unless you set your own with /provider.
While no model of your own is set, Reconix asks first: "Which AI model should Reconix use?". Use the Core API's model keeps the built-in Reconix model; Set a provider… opens /provider.
Start Reconix with the run-eval script (README-<your OS>.md §2). To see the first screen again: quit (Ctrl+Q), then start it with --reset (Windows: -Reset). That only clears ~/.reconix-eval, never your own ~/.reconix; export your /tests results first.

#### PROV-01 · Use the Core API's model

1. Start Reconix fresh (run-eval with --reset).
2. "Which AI model should Reconix use?" → Use the Core API's model (press Enter).
3. Type: who are you?

**Expected:** The Start screen is ready. The answer comes from the Core API's AI; nothing starts.

Result: ☐ Pass ☐ Fail ☐ Skip

#### PROV-02 · A key is masked

1. Quit, start Reconix fresh (run-eval with --reset).
2. Set a provider… → Custom OpenAI-compatible → API key sk-test-0000-1234 → Save provider.
3. Type /provider and look at Custom OpenAI-compatible.

**Expected:** Only sk-…1234 is shown: in the provider list, the form and anywhere else. The full key never shows.

Result: ☐ Pass ☐ Fail ☐ Skip

#### PROV-03 · The question comes back

1. Quit, start Reconix fresh (run-eval with --reset).
2. Choose Use the Core API's model.
3. Quit (Ctrl+Q) and start Reconix again (run-eval, without --reset).

**Expected:** At the next start Reconix asks again: no model of your own is set.

Result: ☐ Pass ☐ Fail ☐ Skip

#### PROV-04 · No question once a model is set

1. With a provider set and active, quit and start Reconix again (without --reset).

**Expected:** No question: the Start screen opens at once and the top bar shows the model.

Result: ☐ Pass ☐ Fail ☐ Skip

#### PROV-05 · Unset the provider

1. /provider → your provider → Unset → Yes, remove it.
2. Quit and start Reconix again (without --reset).

**Expected:** The top bar shows llm: off, and at the next start Reconix asks again.

Result: ☐ Pass ☐ Fail ☐ Skip
